A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Codru-Ji]], the '''father''' of [[Tassa]] led a [[Tassa's clan|clan]] on [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]]. Tassa fell in love with [[Rikkar-Du]], a captive from a rival [[Rikkar-Du's clan|clan]], eventually [[Marriage/Legends|marrying]] and uniting the clans. Tassa's father supported Rikkar-Du following the union.
